'''Fife''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pyke/Legends|Pyke]] and a [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] member during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He fought during the Shadow Collective's [[Battle on Ord Mantell/Legends|battle]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="SoD 2" />
